annotations.title: Set website, app, agent, or skill access

description:
Set who can reach a website, app, agent, or skill: public serves it to anyone who has the link, private serves it to members of the organization that owns it after they sign in to Valet, and to anyone a member has shared it with through share_service, who needs no Valet account, and password serves it to anyone who enters a shared visitor password. Pass kind to say which you mean; a name holding another kind is then refused rather than changed. Apps can be changed only on a server with app access turned on. An agent opens to public or password access only on a server with agent outside access turned on. Changing the mode revokes the access the old mode granted, so confirm the new mode with the user before calling. Requires connecting a Valet account.

Password mode does not take the password. The answer carries a request whose url the person opens, signed in to Valet, to set the shared visitor password; the mode changes only when they do. Say in reason why it needs a password, which only password mode takes. Give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request. Never ask for the password in this conversation. Otherwise the answer carries the access mode now in force and the url, version, and published_at of the live release when the service has one.

kind.description: The kind you believe the named service is, as a safeguard against changing the wrong thing. Omit to change whatever the name holds.

mode.description: Who may open it. public is anyone with the link; private is members of the owning organization and anyone a member has shared it with through share_service; password is anyone who enters the shared visitor password, which a person sets on the request the answer carries.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name, as list_services shows it: the one whose access to set.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

reason.description: Why the request is made, in the words the person reads on the request page, such as: The site holds client drafts, so visitors need a password to open it.

name: set_service_access

access.description: Who can reach the service: public, private, or password. Never includes the visitor password. While a password request is pending, the mode still in force.

kind.description: Kind of the service: site, app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

published_at.description: RFC 3339 time the live release was created. Absent for a service nobody has published.

request.description: The request a person completes in the dashboard to enter a value that must not pass through this conversation. Absent when nothing needs a person.

expires_at.description: When the request expires unanswered, as an RFC 3339 UTC time.

fields.description: Names of what the person enters, never values.

id.description: Id of the request. Pass it to get_request to follow the request.

next_step.description: What to do next: give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request.

url.description: Dashboard page to give the person. They open it signed in to Valet to complete the request. It holds no credential.
Address the service is served at. Absent when it has none, such as a service whose route is gone.

version.description: Version of the live release. Absent for a service nobody has published.

title: Set website, app, agent, or skill access
